spans.s: The final ओ of a vocative singular

before the word इति according to शाकल्य , in a secular or non-vedic literature is a प्रगृह्य।

Terms:

The vowel that has the combination of अनुदात्त and उदात्त tones is said to be स्वरित or circumflexly accented.

Terms: स्वरित

After the verb स्था 'to stand', preceded by सम् , अव , प्र , वि , the आत्मनेपद affix is used.

Terms: आत्मनेपद

After the verbs गम् 'to go', ऋच्छ् 'to become hard', प्रच्छ् 'to ask', स्वर् 'to find fault', ऋ 'to go', श्रु 'to hear' and विद् 'to know', when used intransitively and preceded by सम् , the आत्मनेपद affix is used.

Terms: आत्मनेपद

After the verb नी 'to lead', when used in the sense of 'to guide so as to render the person guided worthy', 'to lift up', 'make one a spiritual guide', 'to determine the true sense', 'to employ on wages', 'to pay debt' and 'to give as in charity', even when the fruit of the action does not accrue to the agent, the आत्मनेपद is used.

Terms: आत्मनेपद

After the verb ज्ञ , preceded by सम् and प्रति , the आत्मनेपद is used, when Not Used in the sense of 'remembering with regret'.

Terms: आत्मनेपद

After the verb गॄ 'to swallow', when preceded by सम् , the आत्मनेपद affix is used in the sense of 'promising'.

Terms: आत्मनेपद

After the verb चर् 'to walk' preceded by सम् , and when connected with a noun in the Instrumental - 3rd Case, the आत्मनेपद is used.

Terms: आत्मनेपद

After the verb क्षणु 'to sharpen', preceded by सम् , the आत्मनेपद is used.

Terms: आत्मनेपद

After the verb यम् 'to strive', preceded by सम् , उत् and आङ् , when it does not refer to a book, the आत्मनेपद is used, when the fruit of the action accrues to the agent.

Terms: आत्मनेपद

A rule which relates to complete words (and not to the roots out of which the words are constructed) is to be understood to apply only to those words the senses of which are connected.

Terms: पद-परिभाषा

The indeclinable word सामि 'half' is compounded with a word ending in the affix क्त and the resulting compound is तत्-पुरुष ।

Terms: समास-तत्-पुरुष

And when the sense is that of addressing, the 1st case-affix is used.

Terms: विभक्ति-1

The affixes शतृ and शानच् are substitutes of लट् (Present Tense) even when agreeing with what ends with a 1st (Nominative Case) case-affix, provided that it is in the Vocative Case.

Terms: लट्

The word ending with the 1st case-affix, in the sense of addressing, is called आमन्त्रित or Vocative.

Terms: विभक्ति-8

The affix क comes after root ख्या 'to tell', when preceded by the preposition सम् and when the object is in compsition with it.

Terms: क

The affix अच् is used after the verbal roots when शम् 'well' is in composition and the word to be formed denotes a name.

Terms: अच्

The affix घिनुण् comes after the 8 verbs beginning with शम् 'to be calm' in the sense of 'the agent having such a habit etc.'.

Terms: घिनुण्

The affix घञ् comes after the roots 1. यु 'to join' 2. द्रु 'to run' 3. दु 'to burn' when in composition with the preposition सम्।

Terms: घञ्

The affix घञ् comes after the verb ग्रह् 'to seize' when in composition with preposition सम् when the sense of the root refers to fist.

Terms: घञ्

The affix अप् comes after the verb अज् 'to go' when the preposition सम् and उत् are in composition and the word so formed refers to beasts.

Terms: अप्

The affix लिङ् (Benedictive) is used after a root, when the expectation (of a person or thing being able or competent to do or suffer the action denoted by the verb is implied (or expressed by any other word used along with them) than 'alarm'.

Terms: लिङ्

The affix तुमुन् comes after a verb when another verb meaning 'to wish' is in construction, provided that the agent of both the verbs is the same.

Terms: तुमुन्

The affix लोट् (Imperative) is similarly added to the root optionally when several themes follow one after another.

Terms: लोट्
In the second case -- समुच्चयेऽन्यतरस्याम्

, where many actions are spoken of together, the verb that is made to follow, should be such as has the sense common to all those verbs.

Terms: लोट्

When two actions have the same agent, the affix क्त्वा comes after that verb which takes place in time anterior to that of the other (i.e. Absolutive in त्व refers to that action which precedes in time).

Terms: क्त्वा

The affix णमुल् comes after the verbs 1. हन् 'to kill' 2. कृ 'to make' 3. ग्रह् 'to seize', when the words 1. समूल 2. आकृत 3. जीव in the Accusative -2nd case are respectively compounded with them.

Terms: णमुल्

(The affix णमुल् comes after a root when a word in the Locative -7th case or Instrumental -3rd case is in composition with it) and when immediate contiguity is intended i.e. 'to fall together by the ears'.

Terms: णमुल्

The तद्धित affixes, on the alternative of their being used at all, comes after the word that is signified by the first of the words in construction in a sūtra.

Terms: तद्धित

The affix ट्लञ् comes in the sense of 'modification or part' after the word शमी।

Terms: ट्लञ्

The affix ठन् and ठक् comes after the words in the Accusative -2nd case in construction denoting combination in the sense 'who assembles there'.

Terms: ठन् and ठक्

The affix यत् comes in the sense of 'resident therein' after the word समानतीर्थ in the Locative -7th case construction.

Terms: यत्

The affix यत् comes in the sense of 'who sleeps' after the word समानोदर in the Locative -7th case construction and the उदात्त falls on the letter ओ।

Terms: यत्

The affix घ comes in the sense of 'what stays there' after the words 1. समुद्र and 2. अभ्र , in the छन्दस् (Vedas).

Terms: घ

The above mentioned affixes have also the sense of 'what is capable of holding that, or takes away that, or cooks that'.

Terms:

The affix ख (ईन) comes in the four-fold senses of 'solicited', 'hired', 'lasted' and 'will last', after the word समा।

Terms: ख
When the affixes ख (ईन) and छ (ईय) coem in the छन्दस् (Vedas) in the five-fold senses taught in पन्थो ण नित्यम्
, तमधीष्टो भृतो भूतो भावी

, after the word वत्सर , when preceded by सम् and परि।

Terms: ख and छ

The affix ठञ् comes after a word in the Instrumental -3rd case in construction in the sense of 'fitted for that'.

Terms: ठञ्

The affix ठञ् comes in the sense of 'that has arrived for it' after the word समय in the Nominative 1st-Case in construction.

Terms: ठञ्

The affix छ (ईय) comes in the same sense of 'that whose purpose is this' after the word समापन when it has a word in composition preceding it.

Terms: छ (ईय)

The affix ख (ईन) comes in the sense of 'who bears in the womb' after the word समांसमाम्।

Terms: ख (ईन)

The affix कटच् (कट) comes after the words 1. सम् 2. प्रद् 3. उद् and 4. वि।

Terms: कटच् (कट)

The affix छ comes, also, only in the sense of 'like this' after a compound noun which contains in itself the force of 'like this'.

Terms: छ
When that, whereof something is made or subsists in, is a multitude, then the affixes expressing a great quantity -- तस्य समूहः

etc. may also be used to denote 'made thereof, subsisting therein'.

Terms:

The affix डाच् comes after the word समय when कृ 'to make' follows, when the sense is that of 'neglecting'.

Terms: डाच्

The following affixes are added to the ends of compounds without changing their sense.

Terms: समासान्त

There is the single substitution of the first vowel for the vocalised semi-vowel and the subequent vowel.

Terms: संहितायाम्

The augment सुट् is placed before क when सम् , परि , and उप are followed by the verb कृ and the sense is that of ornamenting.

Terms: सुट् augment

The augment सुट् is placed before क even when सम् , परि , and उप are followed by the verb कृ and the sense being that of combining.

Terms: सुट् augment

A compound word has the acute on the last syllable.

Terms: accent-समास

स is substituted for समान् in the छन्दस् (Vedas), but not before 1. मूर्धन् 2. प्रभृति and 3. उदर्क।

Terms: स Substitute

समि is substituted for सम् before this अञ्च् when no affix (or व affix) follows.

Terms: Some Substitution

The vowel substituted for a semi-vowel is lengthened when it stands as the first member of a compound.

Terms: संहिता Lengthening

शमिता is formed irregularly by the elision of णि before an इट् augmented affix when meaning a sacrificial act.

Terms: आर्धधातुक changes
आकम् is substituted for the Genitive 6th-Case plural affix साम् -- आमि सर्वनाम्नः सुट्

, after the अङ्ग (stems) युष्मद् and अस्मद्।

Terms: Some substitution

In a compound, the first member of which is an indeclinable but not नञ् ; ल्यप् is substituted for क्त्वा।

Terms: Some substitution

Before the Present characteristic श्यन् , a long is substituted for the root-vowel in शम् and the seven roots that follow it.

Terms: Lengthening

ए is substituted for the final आ of the feminine affix, in the Vocative Case singular.

Terms: गुण in Feminine

रु is substituted for the म् of स्म् (and thereby अँ or अं is substituted for अ) when the augment स् follows in a संहिता ।

Terms: Nasal रु

ष् is substituted for the स् of सङ्ग after the word अङ्गुलि in a compound.

Terms: ष change
